description: This file is a script written in JavaScript/TypeScript syntax, intended to run with Node.js. It is used for analyzing the source code files to identify raw fetch() calls outside an allowlist, particularly in a project involving various communication channels and plugins. It imports several utility modules and defines functions for parsing source files and identifying fetch calls.

methods.name: isRawFetchCall
methods.description: Determines if a given expression node is a raw fetch() call, either directly 'fetch' or 'globalThis.fetch'.

methods.name: findRawFetchCallLines
methods.description: Parses a source file content and returns line numbers of raw fetch() calls outside the allowlist.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that runs the callsite guard analysis across configured source roots to detect raw fetch usage outside the allowed list.
